nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; written in Owned constructor and acceptOwnership, read by onlyOwner modifier and transferAnyERC20Token.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership (two-step ownership transfer).
ERC20 token symbol, set to "GTFO" in the constructor.
ERC20 token name, set to "GTFO" in the constructor.
ERC20 decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply minted to a hard-coded address in the constructor; read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom through safeAdd/safeSub.
Nested allowance mapping (owner => spender => amount); mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Checked addition helper using require(c >= a); called by transfer and transferFrom.
Checked subtraction helper using require(b <= a); called by transfer and transferFrom to move balances/allowances.
Checked multiplication helper; not used by the GTFO token logic.
Checked division helper requiring b > 0; not used by the GTFO token logic.
Owned constructor: assigns msg.sender to owner, establishing initial privileged account.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner (first half of two-step ownership transfer).
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred, then clears newOwner.
GTFO constructor: initializes symbol/name/decimals, mints the entire _totalSupply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw, unchecked arithmetic instead of SafeMath.safeSub.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to `to` using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval without any balance check.
Spends allowance and moves balance from `from` to `to` using safeSub/safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an arbitrary external call to spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data).
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an arbitrary external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, onlyOwner checks, balance debits and allowance bookkeeping.
Unchecked unsigned subtraction `_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]`; underflows if address(0) ever gains a balance.
Arbitrary external call into attacker-supplied `spender` contract via receiveApproval; enables callback/reentrancy into token functions.
Arbitrary external call to an owner-supplied token contract; return value is forwarded but not validated.
Destination address of GTFO.transfer.
Amount of tokens to transfer in GTFO.transfer.
Spender whose allowance is written in GTFO.approve.
Allowance amount written in GTFO.approve.
Source account whose balance and allowance are debited in GTFO.transferFrom.
Destination account credited in GTFO.transferFrom.
Amount moved in GTFO.transferFrom.
Account queried in GTFO.balanceOf.
Allowance owner queried in GTFO.allowance.
Allowance spender queried in GTFO.allowance.
Attacker-controllable contract that receives the external receiveApproval callback.
Allowance amount set before the external call in GTFO.approveAndCall.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the untrusted spender contract.
Arbitrary token contract address called by the owner rescue function.
Amount forwarded to the external token transfer call.
Candidate new owner stored in newOwner by the onlyOwner transferOwnership function.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the initial owner, granting unrestricted privileged control to the deployer.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before ownership can be staged.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in the onlyOwner gate.
_newOwner parameter is written into newOwner.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership gates on require(msg.sender == newOwner) so only the staged owner can complete the transfer.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
GTFO constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
GTFO constructor assigns the name state variable.
GTFO constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
GTFO constructor mints and assigns the entire _totalSupply.
GTFO constructor credits the full supply to a hard-coded address in balances.
_totalSupply feeds the unchecked subtraction performed in totalSupply().
balances[address(0)] feeds the unchecked subtraction; a non-zero zero-address balance underflows the result.
totalSupply() executes raw arithmetic instead of the inherited SafeMath.safeSub, allowing underflow.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances state variable.
transfer debits the msg.sender balance entry.
`to` parameter becomes the destination of the credited balance and of the Transfer event.
`tokens` parameter is the amount debited/credited in transfer.
transfer calls safeSub to debit balances[msg.sender]; the checked call is the only arithmetic guard.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit balances[to].
transfer mutates the balances state variable.
approve writes the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
spender parameter becomes the allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter is written verbatim as the allowance value.
approve mutates the allowed state variable with no balance verification.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], so the caller is a critical input.
`from` parameter is the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
`to` parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
`tokens` parameter is the amount moved and deducted from allowance.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both the balance debit and the allowance debit.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the destination balance credit.
transferFrom mutates the balances state variable.
transferFrom mutates the allowed state variable.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the outer allowance mapping.
spender parameter indexes the inner allowance mapping.
allowance reads the allowed state variable.
approveAndCall sets the allowance keyed by msg.sender and passes msg.sender to the callback.
spender parameter is both the allowance key and the target contract of the external call.
tokens parameter is written to allowed and forwarded into receiveApproval.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim as arbitrary calldata to the untrusted spender contract.
approveAndCall mutates the allowed state variable before the external call.
approveAndCall transfers control to an attacker-supplied contract via receiveApproval(...), opening a callback/reentrancy surface.
The untrusted callee can call back into approveAndCall while the caller's allowance state is already manipulable.
The external callback can re-enter approve (or other token entry points) before the outer call returns.
tokenAddress parameter directly determines the external contract called by the owner rescue function.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token contract and blindly returns the unvalidated boolean.
The arbitrary external token contract executes during transferAnyERC20Token, so a malicious token can re-enter the owner-gated function or the token logic.
owner (protected by onlyOwner) is used as the recipient of the rescued tokens, so a compromised owner drains arbitrary tokens.

normalization_plan.reason: The destination parameter has no meaning outside GTFO.transfer where it indexes balances and the Transfer event.
The amount parameter is only consumed by the safeSub/safeAdd calls inside GTFO.transfer.
The spender parameter is used solely to key the allowed mapping inside GTFO.approve.
The allowance amount is only stored by GTFO.approve.
The source account parameter is only meaningful for the balance and allowance debits in GTFO.transferFrom.
The destination parameter is only meaningful for the credit performed in GTFO.transferFrom.
The amount parameter is only consumed by the safeSub/safeAdd calls in GTFO.transferFrom.
The queried address is a trivial index parameter of the constant GTFO.balanceOf view.
The outer allowance key is a trivial parameter of the constant GTFO.allowance view.
The inner allowance key is a trivial parameter of the constant GTFO.allowance view.
The spender parameter is the untrusted target of the external receiveApproval call, so it should be normalized into that unsafe operation.
The tokens parameter is forwarded into the untrusted callback and the allowance write that immediately precedes it.
The data parameter is arbitrary calldata handed to the untrusted callee and has no other use.
The token address parameter selects the malicious contract invoked by the external call and is only relevant to that unsafe operation.
The amount parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer call and has no independent semantic role.
The candidate owner address is only staged into newOwner inside the onlyOwner transferOwnership function.
